title: Contact/queryChanges: O(N) full list fetch just for insertion indices
description: kith-chat/src/contact.rs:694 — ChatContactQueryChangesHandler calls guard.contacts().list() to fetch all contacts just to compute the addedToPositions indices for newly-added contacts. This is O(N contacts) for every queryChanges call. For large contact lists this degrades. The insertion index could be computed in a single SQL COUNT(*) query per new contact: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM contacts WHERE peer_login < ?1 ORDER BY peer_login ASC.
